title: Email: Fw: Some early ST thoughts

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Friday, February 15, 2019 10:53:42 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Cc: Sulonen, Dana
Subject: Some early ST thoughts 
 
Hey, man: I like some of the stories you’re doing so far. But readers want to know more about the studs, and I don’t think there’s a way to talk about them too much.
Can you find more ways each day to talk about prospects? What do they look like so far? What are folks saying about them? What do you think about them?
That’s why I like observations because it gives you an outlet to write authoritatively on what you’re seeing in a less structured way.
What’s the holdup on doing those every day through the first two weeks of ST?
Yesterday, you sent the beards, which was good. But nothing else in terms of morning updates.
This is something I want these first two weeks. Please make it happen for me.
